support_rows.diagnostic: Windows x64 is the only supported platform row because build, package, install, and native execution evidence all replay on the public objc3c command surface.
Linux x64 remains unsupported until package install and native execution evidence exists on a replayable public path.
macOS arm64 remains unsupported until package install and native execution evidence exists on a replayable public path.

host_identity_records.diagnostic: Windows x64 host identity is promotable only with checked build, package, install, native execution, and toolchain evidence.
Linux x64 host identity is source-owned only; it cannot promote support without real Linux host execution evidence.
macOS arm64 host identity is source-owned only; it cannot promote support without real macOS arm64 host execution evidence.

toolchain_probe_records.diagnostic: Windows x64 toolchain probes are evidence-bound to current checked probe records and do not imply broad version support.
Linux x64 tool presence and source-only probes fail closed until coherent Linux toolchain, package root, and native execution records are checked in.
macOS arm64 tool presence and source-only probes fail closed until coherent Apple/LLVM toolchain, package root, load-path, and native execution records are checked in.

package_root_evidence_records.loader_path_policy: package bin directory and PATH-owned loader resolution are captured by install and native execution evidence
package_root_evidence_records.diagnostic: Windows x64 package root identity is evidence-bound through package, install, and execution evidence.

package_root_evidence_records.loader_path_policy: ELF rpath, RUNPATH, or package-root loader resolution must be proven before support
package_root_evidence_records.diagnostic: Linux x64 package root identity is fail-closed until the ELF package root is built, installed, and executed on Linux x64.

package_root_evidence_records.loader_path_policy: @rpath, install_name, codesign, and package-root loader behavior must be proven before support
package_root_evidence_records.diagnostic: macOS arm64 package root identity is fail-closed until the Mach-O package root, load paths, codesign state, and native execution are proven on macOS arm64.

native_execution_evidence_records.loader_policy: package bin directory and PATH-owned loader resolution are captured by install and native execution evidence
native_execution_evidence_records.diagnostic: Windows x64 native execution evidence is the only current execution record that can participate in support promotion.

native_execution_evidence_records.loader_policy: ELF rpath, RUNPATH, or package-root loader resolution must be proven before support
native_execution_evidence_records.diagnostic: Linux x64 has no checked native execution evidence; source-only ELF/package-root metadata cannot publish support.

native_execution_evidence_records.loader_policy: @rpath, install_name, codesign, and package-root loader behavior must be proven before support
native_execution_evidence_records.diagnostic: macOS arm64 has no checked native execution evidence; source-only Mach-O/package-root/load-path metadata cannot publish support.

negative_host_toolchain_cases.diagnostic: Linux x64 remains unsupported when native Linux host execution evidence is absent.

Generated Linux hosted-runner reports and tool-presence summaries are evidence candidates only; they cannot promote Linux x64 without reviewed checked-in host, package, install, and native execution source truth.
macOS arm64 remains unsupported when native macOS arm64 execution evidence is absent.

Generated macOS hosted-runner reports and tool-presence summaries are evidence candidates only; they cannot promote macOS arm64 without reviewed checked-in host, package, install, load-path, and native execution source truth.
Missing llc or missing llc --filetype=obj blocks native object, package, execution, and platform support.
Mixed LLVM roots block native object, package, execution, and platform support until a single governed root is proven.
Mismatched LLVM tool version families block native object, package, execution, and platform support.
LLVM versions outside checked known-good evidence block native object, package, execution, and platform support.

required_tools.capability: semantic diagnostics and frontend compatibility probe
native runtime link and execution smoke
runtime headers and import libraries discovered from llvm-config or an installed LLVM root

rejection_rules.condition: llc is absent or does not support --filetype=obj
rejection_rules.diagnostic: native object emission is rejected before package or execution support is claimed

rejection_rules.condition: llvm-ar is absent or cannot publish a versioned archive tool identity
rejection_rules.diagnostic: package archive and static-library lanes fail closed before package support is claimed

rejection_rules.condition: LLVM header/library directories cannot be discovered from llvm-config or an installed LLVM root
rejection_rules.diagnostic: headers/libraries discovery fails closed before package or native execution support is claimed

rejection_rules.condition: clang, clang++, llc, llvm-ar, llvm-config, LLVM headers, and runtime libraries resolve from incompatible toolchain roots
rejection_rules.diagnostic: mixed LLVM toolchains fail closed until a single governed matrix entry proves compatibility

rejection_rules.condition: required LLVM tools resolve to different major/minor version families
rejection_rules.diagnostic: mixed LLVM tool versions fail closed before object, package, execution, or platform support is claimed

rejection_rules.condition: a required LLVM tool launches but does not publish a parseable version
rejection_rules.diagnostic: unresolved LLVM tool identity fails closed before object, package, execution, or platform support is claimed

rejection_rules.condition: the probed version is outside known-good evidence
rejection_rules.diagnostic: unsupported LLVM versions fail closed with no range support claim
